notes: Hand-written stand-in for both model outputs until a --live run replaces it: two follow-up questions and an English line script with a step per owner task and an urgent side step that gives the ambulance number digit by digit. Not a model run.

questions.prompt: Should patients bring anything to their visit?
questions.hint: Callers often ask what to carry.

questions.prompt: How does a patient book an appointment?
questions.hint: Say what the agent should take down.

script.business_line: Sunrise Family Clinic, a family doctor's clinic
script.goal: Answer patients' questions and take appointment requests; send emergencies to the ambulance first.
script.opening_line: Hello, this is Asha from Sunrise Family Clinic. How can I help you today?

stages.name: Timings and fees
stages.instruction: Answer questions about when the clinic is open and what a consultation costs, from the facts. Say amounts in words. If they describe chest pain, trouble breathing or heavy bleeding, go to the urgent step at once.

scripts.en-IN: We are open Monday to Saturday, nine in the morning to eight at night.

branches.when: They describe chest pain, trouble breathing or heavy bleeding
They want to see the doctor

stages.name: Appointment
stages.instruction: Book an appointment request: take their name and the time that suits them, then say the front desk confirms the slot by message.

scripts.en-IN: May I have your name, please?

stages.name: Urgent
stages.instruction: Tell them to call the ambulance on 108 right now, said digit by digit as one, zero, eight. Never give medical advice.

scripts.en-IN: Please call the ambulance now on one, zero, eight.

step_outcomes.outcome: Their name and preferred time are taken.
